content: May the stars carry your sadness away; may the flowers fill your heart with beauty; may hope forever wipe away your tears.
author: Native American Proverbs
explanation: This ancient blessing is a sacred invocation of healing: it surrenders personal grief to the cosmic expanse of the stars, invites the fragrant beauty of the earth into the wounded heart, and anchors the spirit in the eternal, unshakeable promise of morning light.
practicalInsight: Offer this gentle blessing in your heart for someone who is struggling today: 'May hope wipe away your tears.'
reflectionPrompt: Can you surrender your lingering sorrows to the vast, peaceful canopy of the stars tonight?
